newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Airlines Apr96-Jan97 loss 998 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Indian Airlines Apr96-Jan97 loss 998 mln rupees.

text.p: State-owned Indian Airlines suffered a net loss of 998 million rupees between April 1996 and January 1997 compared with a 1.18 billion net loss in the same period a year earlier, the government said on Friday.

The statement quoted Civil Aviation Minister C.M. Ibrahim as saying the number of passengers carried by Indian Airlines, the country's domestic carrier, during the quarter ending December 1996 grew by 89.29 percent. He did not specify the number of passengers.
Capacity utilisation by Air India, the state-owned foreign carrier, had improved in the past two years, it added.
Air India had received two new Boeing 747-400 aircraft and added two new stations -- Chicago and Zurich -- to its network.
